messages:
alex: Quick quarterly checkpoint from eng+product — listing what shipped, what slipped, and immediate next steps. TL;DR: runtime v3 canary shipped, embeddings cache rollout delayed, need two CRs merged.

ravi: Shipped: runtime-v3 canary to stage and 10% prod traffic. Observability dashboards look stable. :thumbsup:

mai: Shipped: model-catalog indexing + small UI for pinning model versions. Docs PR merged.

jorge: Slipped: embeddings-cache rollout — blocked by a perf regression in the prefix cache fallback (seen in e2e). Root cause narrowed to async flush ordering.

alex: Jorge, can you add the failing test to the embeddings repo? Put it in a short PR so we can trace.

jorge: Yep, opening PR now. Patch includes a failing test and an extra reorder attempt. ETA for PR: EOD PST.

ravi: Two code review pings: @mai please review #412 (console pin UI followups). @alex can you quick-check #418 (runtime canary: revert guard for a11y logs)? Both are small.

mai: Reviewing #412 this afternoon, will comment.

alex: Will review #418 after stand. If it's safe, we can merge and trigger a brief canary bump.

sre-bot: deploybot: runtime-v3 canary bumped to 25% in prod at 1888880200 — no SLO violations detected in the 30m window.

jorge: Update on embeddings: when the async flush hits a race, we see token duplication in cache metrics. Adding a mutex in the flush path fixes locally but want a cleaner scheduling fix.

mai: Impact to product: embeddings cache delay means higher embedding request costs and slightly increased latency for vector search in some flows. Need a decision: ship temporary mutex or revert cache feature to avoid user impact.

alex: Decision: push temporary mutex with a follow-up issue to optimize scheduling. We prefer predictable correctness over a marginal perf gain. Can we ship mutex + telemetry toggle by tomorrow?

jorge: Yes. I'll open PR for mutex + a feature toggle env var. Add a perf-ticket #456 to track next steps.

ravi: Dependencies check — payments team needs a small schema change to accept the new response envelope from runtime-v3. Has that landed?

mai: Not yet. Payments agreed to accept envelope v2 but needs API docs and a migration window. I can own the contract doc and schedule a 1hr sync with payments this week.

alex: Please schedule that and add owners for the migration: mai (product), ravi (runtime), tina (payments).

mai: Scheduled sync for Thu 10am PT. Calendar invite sent to @tina and payments leads.

ravi: CR follow-ups: if #418 merges, remember to bump canary and monitor KV cache hit rate. I'll add an alert for sudden drop in hit rate.

sre-bot: alertbot: created alert "kv-cache-hitrate-drop" with 15m window and 10% threshold.

alex: Next steps summary — (1) Jorge PR for mutex + toggle (EOD), (2) Mai doc + payments sync (Thu 10am PT), (3) Ravi review and merge #418 (after stand), (4) Monitor runtime canary and cache hit-rate alert.

mai: I'll post a short digest to the #release-notes channel after the payments sync and share migration steps.

jorge: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/embeddings/pull/189 — includes failing test + mutex + toggle. Marked for urgent review.

ravi: Reviewing now. If green, merging and bumping canary.

alex: Thanks all. If anything slips from this plan, please ping me directly.

mai: :thumbsup:

ravi: Merged #418 and bumped canary to 35% at 1888880310. Will watch for anomalies for 1h.

sre-bot: deploybot: runtime-v3 canary bumped to 35% in prod at 1888880310. No SLO alerts in first 10m.

alex: Great. We'll reconvene in async thread if problems appear. End of checkpoint.
